reviews.text:
Since Jan 2023, we have been using Purselley Pools for weekly pool maintenance, service, and needed repairs.

In the office, Emilie has always been friendly, courteous, professional, and 100% responsive to all our pool needs.

The field manager/supervisor Roger is friendly, courteous, professional, and keeps us well-informed - in detail - of the repairs, maintenance, and parts needed for any problems that arise. He is prompt to respond and to efficiently correct the problems, and we appreciate him very much!

Our weekly service tech Frankie is also friendly, courteous, and professional.

We have used other pool companies over the years, but Purselley Pools has been the most dependable and reliable pool company for us, and that is why I am happy to give them a FIVE-STAR review!
reviews.author: TejasTerencio

reviews.text: We have been customers of Purselly for 10 years for our weekly pool service.  We recently needed major repairs and updates to our heating, lighting and wifi system.  We got a detailed bid from them.  Once we decided to move ahead with the work, Roger and his team (Michael and Rupert) came to our house the same day to start the work.  The work was done quickly and Roger spent a lot of time with me showing how the new system worked.  He is very communicative and responsive.  As a side note, our weekly service guy, Alfredo, is very reliable and friendly.  I realized as we completed this extra work that Purselly seems to have very low turn over on their team. I have often recommended Purselley Pool, and I thank you for your years of service - looking forward to many more.
reviews.author: Debbi Jo Thibeau

reviews.text: Purselley Pools is a responsive, friendly and professional pool company.  Their team is extremely knowledgeable and reliable. They are extremely easy to communicate with and have taught us a lot about our pool. Couldn't recommend them more!
reviews.author: Rebecca Rucker

reviews.text: I used Purselley last summer and purchased a very expensive filter housing that didn’t seem to help. This summer when I called them I was quoted$1800 to clear a very dirty pool. After we cleared the leaves and such ourselves we had someone come out. The technician left the pool not better. When I questioned I was told they couldn’t service me this year. I gave them 3 opportunities to call me back before posting a bad review and they don’t seem to care.
reviews.author: Jannae Loury

reviews.text: Purselley Pool has been so reliable and they offer excellent service!  I have an older pool that is hard to keep clean.  When the weather started getting hotter we had some algae problems.  Purselly came out every day that week to check on it.  They scrubbed it each day and added more chemicals and stayed on top of it until it got back to normal.  No extra fees or costs.  I would highly recommend them!!!
reviews.author: Dorenda McDonald

reviews.text: Very professional and responsive. Left the pool looking amazing!! Would highly recommend.
reviews.author: Ian White

reviews.text: I've used Purselley's for many years and the quality of service is superior.  They are very quick to respond if anything needs to be taken care of.  My pool is always beautiful....they even blow the leaves off my deck and back porch!  Very nice touch that is above and beyond the norm.  I highly recommend!!
reviews.author: kathy kubes

reviews.text: Choosing Purselley Pool Service was the best decision I have ever made regarding our pool. They do great work, keep me informed of service issues and allow me and our family to enjoy our pool without having to worry about that awful green algae on the sides of the pool. The water is always crystal clear!!
reviews.author: Cheryl Isom

reviews.text: Purselley built and now maintains our pool.  They did a great job on the construction side and now are going above and beyond to keep the pool clean, operating properly, and ready to use.  They are also very responsive anytime there is an issue.  I highly recommend Purselley Pool and Spa.
reviews.author: Donnie Siratt

reviews.text: I have been using Purselley since 2008.  They completely fixed a problem another company had caused.  They are the best, most knowledgeable, always there, get to know you personally.  I cannot say enough about this service.  I recommend them all the time to everyone with a pool or wanting to get an inspection of a pool...  Cannot beat them.
reviews.author: Karen Hunn

reviews.text: Purselley Pool and Spa has maintained our pool for over 5 years. They are reliable, honest, hard working and fare. Every person who comes out to help us is professional, knowledgable and friendly. They not only provide our weekly cleaning service, but they also maintain any repairs that we need. They are organized and extremely good at what they do. I am so thankful that I have their help with our pool. I would HIGHLY recommend them to build, service and maintain your pool!
reviews.author: Bella Vrana

reviews.text: We have utilized Purselley Pools's services for several years and have always been pleased.  The technicians are consistent and always on time.  Occasionally I will need a repair and I always get a very prompt response.  During my most recent repair request, Roger took the time to explain what had caused my issue and what I can do to address it in the future; this kind of education is very important to me.  Thanks!
reviews.author: Joe Hunt

reviews.text: We have a unique, hand-laid rock swimming pool that after 15 years was needing extensive stone work. After being turned down by several companies, we called Purselley Pool & Spa and what a difference! Baron Purselley came by personally to look over the project and determine what work needed to be done. He proposed several choices and explained everything clearly. When we decided on a plan Baron knew the best stone crew. They helped us choose the stone and then began working as soon as the weather permitted. They were pleasant, professional, efficient, tidy, and did a beautiful job that we are very happy with. Baron knows the pool business top to bottom and we will call on Purselley Pool for our future needs.
reviews.author: Kim Conrow

reviews.text: Purselley Pool and Spa has been a great company to work with.  My father-in-law contacted them to service his pool after his wife of 30 years passed away.  They treated him like family and got his pool back in shape.  I would definitely recommend Purselley to anyone looking for a pool service.  They do an outstanding job.  I am very satisfied with their service and their staff is very friendly.
reviews.author: Sonia Russ

reviews.text: Purselley Pool & Spa did a pool facelift for us recently.  Dark plaster replaced our white plaster, and what a difference that alone made!  They reconfigured the ground-level spa seating and installed a cool modern handrail.  A new pool cleaner and equipment updates made fall leaf-cleanup SO much more effective.  Finally, cosmetic repairs were made to the pool deck & brick, and they had ugly years of limescale cleaned from the blue tile.  Our pool looks fresh, updated, and frankly looks as good as when it was installed 15 years ago, and for a very reasonable price, I might add.  We couldn't be more pleased with the outcome.  Their weekly service is great too.  And you can't beat their responsiveness either.   Customer contact is excellent with all of them.
reviews.author: Andrea Walczak

reviews.text:
Purselley Pools is the best pool service in town. My pool has never looked better and the client support is top notch.  I highly  recommend!!! This is a company with integrity and their service technicians are so polite and informative. Thank you, Purselley Pools for our beautiful, well maintained pool!
Merry and Logan Dickinson
reviews.author: Merry Dickinson

reviews.text: Purselley was able to quickly turnaround a thorough inspection of our pool.  They were prompt and professional.  Overall, we are very happy with their service!
reviews.author: Harrison Helton

reviews.text: Purselley Pools does an excellent job keeping my pool sparkling clean. They are easy to work with and always reliable. I’ve used them for 10 years and always recommend them to friends.
reviews.author: Cindy Low

reviews.text: We have used Purselley since 2007.  They do an awesome job.  I literally don't have to deal with anything regarding the pool.  They handle it all.  I've also used Purselley for our pool remodel and they did wonderful work.  Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Bill Hester

reviews.text:
Great service and great people.  Our pool had a sudden maintenance issue and they were incredibly responsive even though it was discovered on the weekend.  They came to our house ASAP and quickly resolved the issue.

Also, our pool looks great thanks to the weekly cleanings they do! Highly recommend for all your pool needs!
reviews.author: Eric Schmidt

reviews.text: This company has put their information with my friends phone number into a loan generator. She has received 100s of call and text messages on their behalf asking if they need funding, and this has been going on for the last three years.  She receives 10-15 texts and calls a day for funding a business that is not hers. She has reached out to  them on several occasions asking them to please fix this problem and they simply say there is nothing they can do to help and to put her number on the do not call list. However, because the calls were “ Solicited” there’s nothing that she can do to stop the calls. It has gotten so bad that she isn’t even able to answer important phone calls that she may be receiving, because of the constant phone calls for Purselly Pools loan funding. She’s tired of being ignored and unheard by this company that seems to refuse to try to rectify an issue that they have created. My friend is tired of the harassment, And the relentless calls and texts. The way Purselly Pools Has handled this situation it is extremely unprofessional. Not to mention, they have no willingness to help put an end the relentless calls, in reference to their business.
reviews.author: Isabella Monet

reviews.text: I had inherited a pool service company with my new home. After a lackluster performance and an issue with my pool pump, I decided to give Purselley a call. The pump issue was fixed with an honest assessment of a programming problem. I was not met with an attempt of an up-sale of a new pump which many other companies would have tried to do. I appreciated the honesty and integrity of Purselley and now that they manage my pool it looks way cleaner than it ever had before! Thanks!
reviews.author: Kelly Kostohryz

reviews.text: Since we moved into our house we have used Purselley to maintain our pool and we have been very happy with the service. We have never had any problems getting anything done in a timely manner and all our questions are answered quickly. They handle everything so my pool is maintenance free on my part.
reviews.author: kfletch22

reviews.text:
We needed a new cartridge filter tank replaced. We developed some nasty algae, and the day after ridding the pool of algae, our 30+ year old Mitra started bulging.

I called to get a quote on Tuesday, and Purselley was able to get here and knock it out by Thursday. I called multiple places, got some decent quotes - but everyone was booked out due to staffing shortages, parts, etc. Was very pleased with the quick response, and their quoted price was reasonable/tracked with what others had quoted me.

Michael was our tech and knocked it out in less than an hour (and it looks great! He was also very personable/professional).

Michael was also very knowledgeable about how everything worked, and gave us good advice based on how our pool looked (as in how often we should check the filter based on the pressure, our current water cleanliness level, etc)

I would highly recommend using their service, and will be using them again in the future!

Side note - you can communicate with the staff via text, which to me, is very convenient and a bonus.
reviews.author: Jared Smith

reviews.text:
I started with Purselley Pool a couple of years ago upon the recommendation from another pool service company who had been handling my account. I have a good sized pool, and it has been in the ground for decades, so i am sure it presents many challenges to our pool service person.They manage to keep the pool cleaner than my prior service company, and they communicate quickly and clearly  when out of the ordinary service is needed. I would highly recommend Purselley!
Randy Haefli
reviews.author: Randy Haefli

reviews.text: My wife and I recently moved to the area and bought a house with a pool.  We were nervous about caring for the pool as neither of us had any real experience with pool maintenance.  From the very beginning, Baron and all of the Purselley employees were very attentive to our needs.  We have the weekly service and the pool always looks great.  Whenever we go away we can relax as we know the pool is in great hands!
reviews.author: Andrew

reviews.text: Purselly is our first call for any pool maintenance. Great communication, great service, and they won’t over-sell you.
reviews.author: Rob Loar

reviews.text: Always liked this company until they began replacing parts and additional labor fees without asking me. I decided to move to another pool service company and upon their last cleaning they literally put my Polaris pool cleaner in the flowerbed  wadded up with a note that said not working properly! The new pool service determined it wasn’t broken and nothing was wrong. It appeared that the plug in part to the pool side was either cut off or broken off and this worked perfectly prior to canceling. The service was good until the cancel and the unauthorized “repair” and honestly I’m very happy with my new service that is saving me 80 dollars per month. The pool service itself was good just recently didn’t appreciate charges not approved period!
reviews.author: Debra Richichi

reviews.text: I had a “fire pot” that wasn’t working. After numerous attempts to get it repaired without success, Rupert from Purselly pools came out and worked some real magic. Thank you Rupert!  Very professional and knowledgeable. Even came back the next day to service the other fire pot to be sure it works properly!  Highly recommended!
reviews.author: Randy Mills
